title: Bug Bounty Finder Output
description: Bug bounty programs and security.txt records discovered for the given query. One dataset record per program (from HackerOne, Bugcrowd) and per security.txt found, plus one summary record.

programs.title: Bug Bounty Programs & security.txt Records
programs.description: Each record is one of: recordType=program (matched program on HackerOne/Bugcrowd with reward range, scope policy, resolved-report count), recordType=securityTxt (parsed security.txt with contact/policy/encryption URLs), or recordType=summary (final aggregate).
